findings.detail: The first R8 verifier implementation checked claimed file hashes and reran required tests, but its completeness check was a stub, so a PASS worker result could omit real changed files and still be accepted. The adversarial regression test reproduced the defect, repair mission R8-B dispatched a fresh repair worker that replaced the stub with an actual-vs-claims completeness check, the mission was reverified and accepted, and the identical accepted artifact was applied to the R8-owned source.
findings.title: Initial verifier trusted worker completeness claims

findings.detail: Bandit runs clean on the mandatory orchestration source gate; a separate advisory run over scripts/remaster/r8 is recorded in R8_STATIC.json and is not part of the mandatory gate.
findings.title: Bandit advisory scope includes R8 gate scripts

findings.detail: Rollback restoration in the proving area initially failed on read-only git object files on Windows. R8 path clearing now chmods read-only files before removal, confined to the proving root.
findings.title: Windows read-only git objects require read-only-safe clear

findings.detail: Round-2 verifier found PRE_EXISTING_BASELINE listed FINDINGS.jsonl and OWNER_REDIRECT_R6_DEFERRED.json as dirty although they are committed clean at the R7 PASS HEAD. The baseline now lists only genuinely pre-existing entries (R6 deferred trees and the R8 work package), and _confinement records baseline_entries_missing when any listed entry is absent, so the claim is self-checked against live porcelain.
findings.title: Builder baseline porcelain claim was not reproducible

findings.detail: Round-2 verifier measured evidence_bytes 637580 claimed vs 637701 on disk, non-deterministic across replays. evidence_bytes() is now defined as the total of all evidence files EXCLUDING the self-referential builder report and the artifact manifest, so the value is stable before/after the final closure writes and reproducible by the verifier.
findings.title: evidence_bytes claim was not reproducible

findings.detail: The orchestrator now appends a MissionLink on every accepted mission, bound to the accepted-event ledger header; the shared r8_store persists lineage for accepted asset and repair missions (round-2 verifier confirmed).
findings.title: MissionLink store was empty operationally

findings.detail: ensure_relative_safe now refuses drive/URI forms (':') and NUL bytes; evidence/artifacts lists are path-validated fail-closed; regression tests and round-2 verifier probes confirm structured WorkerResultError rejection and an end-to-end REJECTED mission with no acceptance and no verifier crash.
findings.title: Worker result schema accepted Windows drive-letter paths

findings.detail: Cosmetic: R8_FULL_SUITE_RAW.txt does not include the final 'N passed' lines; JUnit counts and exit codes are authoritative and were reproduced green.
findings.title: Full-suite raw outputs omit pytest summary lines

findings.detail: The shared mission ledger is append-idempotent, so the round-2 machinery rerun appended no new events and both MissionLinks captured the same final chain head instead of each mission's accepted-event header. The machinery evidence was regenerated from a clean ledger/store so links bind the accepted-event headers; a gate assertion checks per-mission link headers against the acceptance event header.
findings.title: Frozen store links recorded the final ledger head
